messages:
alex.support: Hey team, customer CAR-942 (tenant id t-9b2) reports metrics missing in Console for their Private VPC deployment after we rolled out an auth-sidecar update yesterday. Dashboard shows 0 requests and no latency, but their gateway logs show traffic hitting the control plane.

ben.eng: Can you paste repro steps + a sample request? Also link to tenant org id so I can check dashboard filters.

alex.support: Repro steps:
1) From customer VPC, curl to https://private-api.redwood.internal/v1/generate
2) Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>, X-RW-Tenant: t-9b2
3) Response 200 with model tokens. Console dashboard (Filters: tenant=t-9b2, timeframe=24h) shows empty.

carla.customer: Confirmed. We updated the auth sidecar to 1.8.2 in our cluster yesterday at ~14:00 UTC. No other infra changes on our side.

dani.devops: Quick check of ingress logs on the control-plane shows incoming requests with an empty tenant header. Example snippet from gateway log:
```
[2026-03-12T14:22:10Z] src=10.2.1.11 dst=api-gw rw_tenant=\"\" status=200 path=/v1/generate
```

alex.support: Customer says they sent X-RW-Tenant, but the control plane shows blank. Sounds like the sidecar or proxy is stripping/rewriting headers. New sidecar defaults sometimes drop custom headers unless forward_headers=true.

ben.eng: @dani can you inspect the proxy config in their Private control plane? Check nginx/traefik rules and any env flags like FORWARD_INTERNAL_HEADERS / strip_untrusted_headers.

dani.devops: Found it: their proxy config has `strip_untrusted_headers: true`. During the 1.8.2 rollout we changed the untrusted header list and X-RW-Tenant got classified as untrusted. Rolling a rollback now. :rocket:

infra-bot: Deploy 3345 -> rollback started by dani.devops at 2026-03-12T15:05:02Z :white_check_mark:

erin.prod-analytics: Note: our metrics ingestion keys on the tenant header. When the header is missing we route events to the \"unknown\" tenant bucket, and the Console UI filters out unknown by default, so counts appear as zero for the customer's tenant. That matches what you're seeing.

carla.customer: After the rollback the tenant header is visible again and metrics are re-populating in Console. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

ben.eng: Root cause: config change marked X-RW-Tenant as untrusted, so it was stripped before metrics enrichment. Action items: 1) add e2e test for tenant-header preservation in Private sidecar upgrades (owner: ben.eng); 2) update runbook to verify header forwarding after sidecar upgrades (owner: dani.devops); 3) add a dashboard alert when a previously active tenant's metric series drops to zero unexpectedly (owner: erin.prod-analytics).

alex.support: Thanks everyone — I'll keep this thread open until the runbook PR merges. :thumbsup:
